records.text:
Regular color Doppler ultrasound revealed irregular hypoechoic areas in the left breast and clear echo boundaries of multiple lymph nodes in the left axilla, with no obvious abnormal blood flow signal in the bilateral breasts.
The molybdenum target showed a patchy tortuous structure in the upper outer quadrant of the left mammary gland accompanied by punctate calcification and calcium salt deposition, but no definite mass shadow was found.
Microscopically, tumor cells presented variety of arrangement patterns including vesicular, tubular, and striated patterns. No vascular or nerve invasion seen.
AR (moderate strength positive), E-Cadherin (+), Ki-67 (positive index about 40%), SOX10 (+), S100 (+), GCDFP-15 (+), PASD (+), PD-L1 (combined positive score = 3)
